content.introduction: The 12-month percentage change for the Consumer Price Index (CPI) for selected categories in August 2026 is as follows: All items at 3.4%, Food at 2.7%, Food at home at 2.2%, Cereals and bakery products at 2.6%, Meats, poultry, fish, and eggs at 1.1%, Dairy and related products at -0.3%, Fruits and vegetables at 3.2%, Nonalcoholic beverages and beverage materials at 3.7%, Food away from home at 3.4%, Full service meals and snacks at 3.5%, Limited service meals and snacks at 3.2%, and Energy at 16.3%. These figures are provided by the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.
